headline: Pakistan's ruling party leads in Kashmir vote despite boycott call by banned group
context: Candidates backed by twice-elected former Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League-N party have won 24 of the 34 seats decided in the first two phases of voting, the election commission, said Wednesday.

sources.name: NPR
